planting.note: Start indoors well ahead of the last frost and transplant only once nights stay warm, since this variety sulks in cool soil.

directions: Thalana Batu is a small, round, spiny-calyxed eggplant traditional to Sri Lanka, producing golf-ball to tennis-ball sized fruit with pale green and cream streaking. The spiny calyx and stem are a hallmark of the type and should be trimmed away before cooking. It is a staple of Sri Lankan curries, especially in coconut-milk based moju and tempered sambols where the firm flesh holds its shape. Give it full sun, steady moisture, and warm soil, and stake taller plants since the fruit load can be heavy for the stems.
sources: diaspora heirloom seed exchanges specializing in South Asian vegetables

planting.note: Grow from rooted stem cuttings trained up a sturdy post or tree, as this vine needs years of warm, humid, frost-free conditions before it fruits reliably.

directions: Kampot pepper is the famous black, white, and red pepper of Cambodia's Kampot and Kep provinces, grown on volcanic, sandy-loam soil under tropical humidity, and it carries geographical-indication protection recognizing its distinct bright, slightly citrusy heat. The vine climbs a post or living support and needs several years of growth before producing its first substantial harvest of drupes, which are picked at different ripeness stages to yield the black, red, or white forms of the same berry. It thrives in consistently warm, humid, well-drained conditions with light shade from taller companion trees. Outside the tropics it can only be grown as a container specimen overwintered indoors.

planting.note: Plant hardwood cuttings or a grafted sapling in full sun on well-drained ground, and expect several years before fruiting begins in earnest.

directions: Goychay pomegranate is the landrace group grown around the city of Goychay in Azerbaijan, a region whose dry, hot summers and mineral-rich soils produce intensely sweet-tart arils and are celebrated each year at Azerbaijan's national Pomegranate Festival. Trees are drought-tolerant once established and benefit from a deep watering during fruit set followed by drier conditions as fruit ripens to concentrate sugars and reduce splitting. It fruits reliably within a Mediterranean-type climate and tolerates poor soil but needs full sun and good drainage to avoid root rot. Fruit is eaten fresh, juiced, or reduced into the narsharab sauce used throughout Azerbaijani and wider Caucasian cooking.
sources: Azerbaijan Ministry of Agriculture regional product documentation

planting.note: Start indoors and transplant into rich, consistently moist, well-drained beds after frost, mimicking the floating-garden silt beds this variety was selected for.

directions: Inle Lake Tomato is the productive, thin-skinned tomato landrace grown on the floating hyacinth-root garden beds of Myanmar's Inle Lake in Shan State, where farmers build up mounded beds of lake weed and silt that stay constantly moist from below. The plants respond well to heavy, steady watering and rich organic mulch, reflecting their origin in beds that are essentially always irrigated. Fruit is medium-sized, juicy, and mild, used throughout Myanmar in salads, soups, and the tomato-based condiments served with Shan noodle dishes. On ordinary ground it still performs best with generous, even moisture and fertile, well-drained soil rather than the floating-bed system itself.
sources: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) reporting on Inle Lake floating agriculture

planting.note: Direct-sow after the soil has warmed and frost danger has passed, matching the short, cool highland growing season of the Korça basin where this bean originates.

directions: Korça Bean is the bush dry-bean landrace long associated with the high Korça basin of southeastern Albania, a cool plateau region whose bean harvests have been a staple local crop and market export for generations. It is grown as a bush type without staking, direct-sown once the ground has warmed, and left on the plant until pods dry fully before threshing. The dried beans are used in Albanian fasule stews and bean soups, valued for cooking down to a creamy texture. It prefers full sun, even moisture during flowering and pod-fill, and a well-drained bed, with watering tapered off as pods mature and dry.
sources: Albanian Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development regional crop reporting

planting.note: Direct-sow or set small bulbils in full sun after frost danger passes, and expect clusters of small bulbs to form rather than one large onion.

directions: Jaffna Red Onion is a small, pungent, multiplier-type shallot onion landrace grown on the sandy soils of Sri Lanka's Jaffna peninsula, historically one of the island's most important onion-producing regions. Each planted bulb divides into a cluster of several small reddish bulbs rather than forming a single large onion, so harvest involves lifting and separating the whole cluster once tops yellow and dry down. The pungent, concentrated flavor makes it prized for sambols, tempering oil, and the base of Sri Lankan curries. It wants full sun, light sandy well-drained soil, and moderate water that is reduced as bulbs mature to avoid rot.
sources: Hector Kobbekaduwa Agrarian Research and Training Institute
